title: Column marginals sum to one
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a joint distribution on $\mathrm{Fin}\,M \times \mathrm{Fin}\,N$. Then the column marginals sum to one: $\sum_{j} \sigma^{\mathrm{col}}_j = 1$.
hypotheses_covered: σ is a joint distribution on Fin M × Fin N
replaced:
The column marginals form a valid probability distribution:
$\sum_{j} \sigma^{\mathrm{col}}_j = 1$.
